meta.title: Almost For Ever
meta.description: Persistent memory and a local Markdown knowledge base for DSH. Automatically recalls relevant notes on every turn with tag, title and body ranking, injecting only matching line ranges. Open “🗂 记忆库” for full-text search and a visual atlas centered on AGENTS.md: read, add, edit and delete entries and sections with version-conflict protection and snapshot undo. Model-proposed writes still require sticky-note confirmation. No database, embedding service or hand-maintained index; reads and writes only local memory files and AGENTS.md.
